decision.previous_status: m_csa:611, m_csa:657, and m_csa:1001 were blocked because high metal-dependent-hydrolase retrieval scores were paired with loose conformation, inter-domain or oligomeric role-pair distance, or cofactor-locality uncertainty.
decision.policy_summary: Loose active-site geometry, inter-domain role pairs, oligomeric role pairs, and cofactor-locality exceptions may become countable only when explicit structural evidence shows that the catalytic residues, expected cofactor, and relevant water or substrate-ligand context form one active catalytic unit in the selected biological assembly or a remapped alternate structure. High retrieval score, mechanism text, structure-wide cofactor presence, or one local cofactor contact alone is insufficient.
minimum_structural_evidence_for_future_c: all scored and catalytically necessary M-CSA residues must have residue-level mappings in the selected structure, biological assembly, or a named remapped alternate
the expected cofactor must be local to the active-site residue set by atom-level evidence, not only present structure-wide
metal-ligand roles must have direct coordinating-atom evidence or an explicit curated remap to direct metal-ligand residues
acid/base-plus-metal-locality cases can count only when the acid/base residue is atom-level local to the same metal/water/substrate pocket as the direct metal-ligand residues

if a scored focus pair is far apart because of open conformation, domain motion, or oligomeric context, a closed-conformation alternate, biological-assembly mapping, or explicit role-pair locality evidence must show the pair participates in the same catalytic unit
the row must then pass a dedicated import preview, full label-factory gates, and batch acceptance for only the eligible row set
not_allowed_as_counting_evidence: entry name, EC, Rhea, or source annotation alone
structure-wide metal or cofactor hits without local active-site support
high current retrieval score when the relevant active-site roles remain spatially unresolved
ad hoc threshold lowering or candidate-specific scoring exceptions
decision.dedicated_import_preview_not_run_reason: No evaluated row is import-gate eligible under the v1 policy and current evidence. The canonical count remains 695 -> 695.
